verdict.rationale: Google Cloud's agent platform (Vertex AI) could plausibly consume external MCP servers, so this axis applies. However, the evidence only shows Google publishing MCP servers that external clients connect to (the Cloud Run MCP server and MCP Toolbox for Databases). That is the server role and does not transfer to this client-side story. The Vertex AI material mentions agentic systems generally but never says Google Cloud can plug in MCP servers and use their tools.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
